The candidate declares shown_when retirement.h_smw (account = plan and annuity true), which triage.mjs does not apply to the candidate side (suspected tooling defect, see the summary). Re-run in scratch with the candidate's shown_when applied: 2,346 of 2,379 agree; the 33 left are partial records withholding retirement.annuity on IRA entries (23 value, project $0.00 shown, candidate hidden; 10 project-unknown; 4 and 6 of them completed returns). The candidate's account guard is right and the project's condition is the defect: finding F5. The line's value is the project's wherever both show it (the bands and the prior-year branch are the same as round 4).
